# Verification: canonical-v2-provider-compat-self-contained

## Status

Accepted as of `2026-07-21T03:57:07Z` (UTC). The external/root targeted final review reported
`C0/I0` (`C=0`, `I=0`) and explicitly authorized acceptance. All reconciled required checks and
scope receipts have evidence below. Under the non-recursive sequence, this Accepted document is
frozen before the write-once acceptance receipt is created.

The current worktree already contains unrelated user-owned dirty state. This contract keeps that
worktree and requires those unrelated bytes to remain unchanged; no replacement worktree is planned.

## Diagnosis evidence

### Ignored root dependency

```bash
nl -ba .gitignore | sed -n '251,253p'
git check-ignore -v openai_client_compat.py
git ls-files --error-unmatch openai_client_compat.py
```

Observed: `.gitignore:252` contains `/openai_client_compat.py`; `git check-ignore` attributes the
ignore to that rule; `git ls-files --error-unmatch` exits 1; the target worktree has no root helper.

Read-only inspection found the same top-level-import/dynamic-root-loader pattern in:

- `apps/miroflow-agent/src/data_agents/providers/qwen.py:9-29`
- `apps/miroflow-agent/src/data_agents/providers/mirothinker.py:9-27`

The ignored host helper contains primary construction and the existing `socksio`/`proxies` retries
captured in the contract.

### Clean import reproduction

From a fresh temporary cwd, this was executed with `PYTHONPATH` removed and only the tracked app root
inserted into isolated Python:

```bash
env -u PYTHONPATH apps/miroflow-agent/.venv/bin/python -I -c \
  'import importlib, sys; sys.path.insert(0, "<worktree>/apps/miroflow-agent"); importlib.import_module("src.data_agents.providers.qwen"); importlib.import_module("src.data_agents.providers.mirothinker")'
```

Observed exit status `1`: `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'openai_client_compat'`, followed by
`FileNotFoundError` for `<worktree>/openai_client_compat.py`. This is diagnosis only, not the required
assertion-based RED.

`apps/miroflow-agent/pyproject.toml:69-70` configures Hatch packages as
`["src", "canonical_v2_alembic"]`. No fresh wheel has been built yet.
